title: Normalize canonical Lenskit checkout after active sessions
goal: Attach /home/alex/repos/lenskit to the current main branch only after all active processes using the checkout are classified or finished, while preserving detached publication-source worktrees and any unique branch state.

acceptance.assertion: No Claude, Grabowski stdio, rLens or shell process has the canonical checkout as cwd or command target at the moment of branch attachment, unless explicitly classified safe and quiescent.
The canonical checkout is clean and HEAD equals origin/main; local main is fast-forwarded without reset, stash, rebase or loss of unique commits.
RepoBrief publication-source and tool worktrees remain detached and unchanged.
After attachment, branch is main, status is clean, HEAD equals origin/main, rLens/RepoBrief services remain healthy and active worktrees are unchanged.

metadata.live_finding: Canonical checkout was clean and exactly at origin/main but detached while multiple Claude, Grabowski stdio and rLens processes used it.
metadata.block_reason: The historical process blocker is cleared, but the canonical Lenskit checkout is a foreign dirty feature branch. Its uncommitted .gitignore change adds .mcp.json; attaching main now would overwrite, stash or absorb unclassified local work.
metadata.next_action: The checkout owner must classify the local +.mcp.json ignore rule and preserve any needed branch state. Then re-read processes, branch containment and dirty state; attach main only when the checkout is clean and exact origin/main attachment is lossless.

blocker_refresh.current_block_reason: No active process now blocks attachment. The remaining blocker is ownership and preservation of the foreign uncommitted .gitignore change plus safe classification of the feature branch before any branch switch.
required_to_unblock: Owner-classify the +.mcp.json line as local-only, publishable or discardable.
Preserve any required branch state without reset or stash.
Repeat a target-specific process and Git readback immediately before attaching main.
does_not_establish: permission to delete or take over the feature branch
safe attachment to main before owner classification
